before: Deleting shared binary and relationship entries collapsed concurrent image retirements, allowing one actor undo to revive another actor retired resource.
after: Retirement keeps existing descriptor maps and clears the existing digest or relationship id scalar. Ordinary descriptor puts remain atomic. Application-owned history retains independent retirement intentions.
reason: Every existing reader already omits empty digests and empty relationship identifiers. Reader implementations and version fields remain unchanged. This corrects writer history behavior without introducing shared fields or a new room format.
